site.heroText: We connect fresh faces with real, paid brand opportunities across Nepal — fashion shoots, café promotions, lifestyle campaigns, and digital ads.
site.aboutText: Silver Fox Models is a commercial talent agency working with Nepali brands on fashion shoots, café promotions, lifestyle campaigns, and digital ads. Brands are often looking for fresh faces for social media content or promotional material, and we handle the pitching and booking process on behalf of our models.

howItWorks.title: We pitch and book
howItWorks.text: We bring your look to brands we work with and handle the outreach and booking on your behalf.

howItWorks.title: You get paid directly
howItWorks.text: If a brand confirms a project, payment goes straight to you — never through us.

howItWorks.title: We take 25% commission
howItWorks.text: Only from confirmed, paid bookings. Never upfront, never before you're paid. No joining fees, no hidden charges.

howItWorks.title: Everything in writing
howItWorks.text: Before any shoot, you receive a written agreement covering the project, payment, and usage rights.

models.name: Cherisa Baniya
models.about: An emerging commercial model with a strong background in travel content creation. She manages her own social media platform and brings high-quality visual storytelling and a natural, confident camera presence to every project.

models.name: Suhana Shrestha
models.about: A digital-savvy commercial model and travel vlogger with a strong storytelling presence. As a business owner herself, she brings genuine understanding of brand positioning, audience engagement, and authentic visual communication.

models.name: Raj Bogati
models.about: An emerging young commercial talent with a fresh and versatile look. His sharp, contemporary appearance and natural confidence in front of the camera make him an ideal fit for brands targeting a younger, digitally active audience.

models.name: Utshav Bogati
models.about: A dynamic young lifestyle model with a modern and adaptable appearance. His approachable, relatable energy makes him a natural fit for digital-first campaigns and brands that want to connect authentically with young consumers.
